adminPage.userAccessDescription: Create invited users, assign projects, and manage access.
adminPage.usersDescription: Role-scoped access for invited SitePulse users.

invitePage.title: Set your password
invitePage.description: Complete your SitePulse account setup with the name you want to show across the workspace.
invitePage.invalidOrExpired: Invitation link is invalid or expired

sidebar.workspaceNoteBody: Keep alerts, reports, and plan progress aligned before every site review.

shell.supportBody: Keep camera health, alert response, and progress reporting aligned before each review cycle.

overview.heroDescription: Review camera-observed progress signals, plan coverage, and alert pressure before moving into detailed site evidence.
overview.noMetrics: No metrics data available yet. Run the analysis engine first.
overview.reviewAlertsDescription: Review the queue to confirm which delays need action first.
overview.last12Weeks: Rolling view of the latest 12 weeks of camera-observed site signals.
overview.kpiActivityIndexNote: Relative to this project's busiest observed week.
overview.kpiActiveHoursNote: Observed active periods across the latest 7 days.
overview.kpiInactiveDaysNote: Days with good visibility but no meaningful site movement.
overview.kpiUnknownDaysNote: Days with too little evidence or limited visibility.
overview.activityChartDescription: Weekly movement intensity across the same 12-week window.
overview.summaryProgress: Observed progress delta is {{value}}% for the latest week. Use it as a camera-observed signal, not certified completion.
overview.summaryActivity: Activity index at {{value}} shows how active the site appears relative to its busiest observed week.
overview.summaryActiveHours: {{hours}}h of observed active periods were detected across {{count}} camera zones in the last 7 days.
overview.operationsDescription: Use this summary to decide whether the team should move into alerts, plan review, or image verification next.
overview.chartInterpretationBody: Positive values mean stronger observed site activity and change than the previous week. Negative values mean weaker observed activity and change. This is a camera-observed signal, not a certified schedule update.
overview.dailyActivityDescription: Recent day-level classification from detections, movement signals, and weather observations.
overview.latestDailyBriefingDescription: The most recent operational narrative for the latest observed day.
overview.latestWeeklyInsightDescription: Narrative context for the latest observed weekly progress signal.
overview.noNarrativeDescription: Daily and weekly AI reports will appear here once reports are generated for this project.
overview.noDailyActivity: No daily activity classification is available yet.
overview.noDailyActivityNote: No summary note available for this day.
overview.recentFlagsDescription: Latest issues surfaced from schedule, safety, anomaly, and weather checks.
overview.noRecentFlags: No recent flags for this project.

alertsPage.title: Alerts
alertsPage.description: Prioritize construction risks, review response history, and keep teams aligned on the alerts that need action first.
alertsPage.filterDescription: Refine the alert stream by signal type, severity, and response status.
alertsPage.emptyTitle: No alerts match the current filters.
alertsPage.emptyDescription: Try broadening the filters to review the wider alert history.

planPage.title: Construction plan
planPage.description: Upload current planning documents, compare milestone expectations against observed site progress, and catch delays early.
planPage.uploadDescription: Drag a PDF into the drop zone or browse from disk. Uploaded plans are parsed for milestone tracking.
planPage.uploadingDescription: This can take a few moments for larger documents.
planPage.dropDescription: Or browse files manually to upload the latest construction plan.
planPage.noMilestonesDescription: Upload a plan to generate milestone tracking and progress checks.

progressPage.title: Progress analytics
progressPage.description: Review camera-observed progress signals, activity intensity, and delay risk signals across recent construction weeks.
progressPage.averageWeeklyDeltaNote: Average week-over-week signal in the selected window.
progressPage.bestObservedWeekNote: Highest observed weekly movement and change.
progressPage.averageActiveHoursNote: Typical observed work window across the selected weeks.
progressPage.currentRiskLevelNote: Signal derived from recent activity patterns.
progressPage.weeklyDescription: Track week-over-week camera-observed progress signals derived from site activity and change patterns.
progressPage.currentReadoutDescription: The latest weekly observed signal translated into operational guidance.
progressPage.comparedAgainst: Compared against {{count}} weeks in the selected historical window.
progressPage.confidenceBody: This page reflects camera-observed progress signals based on detections, movement, and active periods. It does not yet confirm planned-vs-actual schedule completion.
progressPage.activityIndexDescription: Use this to spot quieter or busier weeks relative to the site's own baseline.
progressPage.activeHoursDescription: Observed active periods over the most recent seven-day range.
progressPage.howMetricReadDescription: Observed progress delta shows how site activity and visible change moved compared with the previous week.
progressPage.metricReadBody0: Positive delta means stronger observed movement and change than the prior week. Negative delta means weaker observed movement and change than the prior week.
progressPage.metricReadBody1: Use the chart alongside the timeline and compare views. High activity with low delta often signals staging, prep, logistics, or weather disruption rather than completed scope.
progressPage.metricReadBody2: Sustained low deltas paired with elevated risk signals are a strong reason to review milestone evidence and the plan page.

comparePage.noSnapshotsDescription: Run the image sync first to unlock before and after comparison.
comparePage.errorTitle: Unable to load snapshots for comparison
comparePage.controlsDescription: Select two daily capture dates and drag the divider to inspect visible changes between snapshots.
comparePage.visualDescription: Touch, drag, or use the slider above to inspect the two selected daily snapshots.
comparePage.sameSelectionWarning: Choose two different capture dates to reveal a meaningful visual comparison.
comparePage.metricChangesDescription: These values compare the weekly metrics for the weeks containing the selected snapshot dates.
comparePage.metricContextNote: The images above are daily snapshots. The values below provide weekly context for the weeks those dates belong to, not exact measurements for each single image.
comparePage.changeProgress: Observed progress delta moved from {{from}}% to {{to}}% ({{delta}}%).
comparePage.changeHours: Observed active hours shifted from {{from}}h to {{to}}h.
comparePage.changeRiskChanged: Delay risk signal changed from {{from}} to {{to}}.

timelinePage.title: Site timeline
timelinePage.description: Scrub through capture history, isolate a specific week, and review visual evidence behind observed progress signals.
timelinePage.scrubbingHint: Use the week and date dropdowns or the range slider to move through the image sequence.
timelinePage.keyboardHelp: Focus the viewer and use Left and Right arrows to move between captures. Press Space to play or pause.
timelinePage.empty: No snapshots available yet. Run a sync and detection first.

activityPage.title: Activity diagnostics
activityPage.description: Use this page to review site activity signals and supporting evidence behind observed progress. It is operational context, not certified completion.
activityPage.scoreDescription: Based on people count, vehicle movement, and observed active periods over the last 7 days.
activityPage.scoreLimitation: Treat this as an operational activity signal. It does not confirm planned work completion on its own.
activityPage.activeHoursTitle: Observed active hours per day (14 days)
activityPage.heatmapDescription: Hourly heatmap of detected site activity. Use it to spot recurring site rhythm, not delivery certainty.
activityPage.heatmapUnavailableBody: No hourly heatmap data is available for this project yet. SitePulse is not showing estimated fallback activity here.
activityPage.privacyBody: Aggregated counts only. No identity tracking. SitePulse processes anonymized object detection data with no facial recognition or personal identification.

reportsPage.title: AI Reports
reportsPage.description: Review recurring AI briefings and create custom analyses for specific time windows.
reportsPage.generateDescription: Create an ad hoc AI summary for a selected date range. Scheduled daily and weekly reports appear below as separate history sections.
reportsPage.analyzing: Analyzing site photos with GPT-4o Vision. This may take 30-60 seconds...
reportsPage.noReportsDescription: Daily briefings, weekly summaries, and custom analyses will appear here once generated.
reportsPage.evidenceSectionDescription: Open the exact images used as evidence for this report.
reportsPage.lowConfidenceDescription: This report is based on limited visual evidence for the selected period.
reportsPage.emptyTitle: Select a report from the sidebar, or generate a new one.
reportsPage.emptyDescription: AI reports analyze site photos and metrics to assess construction progress.

daily.title: Daily Briefings
daily.description: Operational day-level summaries for site leads and coordinators.

weekly.title: Weekly Summaries
weekly.description: Trend-based weekly narratives for project coordination and review.

custom.title: Custom Analyses
custom.description: Manual date-range summaries created for ad hoc investigation.

settingsPage.title: Settings
settingsPage.readOnlyTitle: Only project profile settings are editable today
settingsPage.readOnlyDescription: Monitoring and notification preferences are visible, but the current backend does not persist changes to those fields yet.
settingsPage.readOnlyHint: Read-only for now. The current backend only saves project name and location.
settingsPage.profileHelp: Contact an administrator if your personal details need to be updated.
settingsPage.notificationHelp: Alert notifications will be sent to this email address when new flags are detected.
